payload.title: Old posts are read once
payload.context: M6 review (#6): posts published before insights existed would have stayed unmeasured for ever, leaving the 28 and 90 day views empty.
payload.rationale: A published post that was never read is read once even when older than the reading window, up to a year back by default, after posts still in their window and inside the same rate share.
payload.consequences: The first days after deploy fill in history gradually. NOONGUN_INSIGHTS_BACKFILL_DAYS set to 0 turns it off.
